programme.title: Plötzlich Familie
programme.desc:
„Wir könnten ’nen Fünfjährigen adoptieren, dann wär’s, als hätte ich ihn mit 36 gekriegt.“ Pete (Mark Wahlberg) quatscht das so dahin, weil ihn der plötzliche Kinderwunsch seiner Frau Ellie (Rose Byrne) nervt. Andererseits: Obwohl es Pete und Ellie durch das Aufmöbeln und Weiterverkaufen alter Häuser zu Wohlstand gebracht haben, fehlt ihnen etwas. So entschließen sich die beiden tatsächlich zur Adoption. 

Statt eines Fünfjährigen nehmen sie dann allerdings die fünfzehnjährige Lizzy (Isabela Moner, „Sicario 2“) bei sich auf – und auch gleich noch deren elfjährigen Bruder Juan und Schwesterchen Lita. Zunächst läuft es sehr harmonisch. Doch die Ladys von der Adoptionsagentur (klasse: Octavia Spencer und Tig Notaro) warnen: Die „Flitterwochenphase“ währt nicht lange… 

Regisseur Sean Anders („Daddy’s Home“) ließ sich beim Schreiben des Drehbuchs von persönlichen Erfahrungen inspirieren, und das Herzblut merkt man dem Film an. Obwohl die drei Filmkids weit entfernt von einem „Systemsprenger“ sind, setzt sich die Komödie ernsthaft mit der Not von Pflegekindern und der Überforderung von Adoptiveltern auseinander. Wahlberg und Byrne spielen das etwas unreife, aber liebenswert bemühte Elternpaar absolut sympathisch.

programme.title: Kuck' mal, wer da spricht
programme.desc:
Die alleinerziehende Molly (Kirstie Alley) bekommt Berufs- und Privatleben nicht geregelt. Baby Mikey (gespielt von vier verschiedenen Babies und Kleinkindern) verlangt ihre volle Aufmerksamkeit. Doch dann tritt Taxifahrer James (John Travolta) in ihr Leben. Der hatte sie als Hochschwangere ins Krankenhaus gefahren und verfolgt mit Mikeys Einverständnis seither nur ein Ziel: Er will die flotte Mutter erobern…

Kleine Kinder und Tiere kommen beim Publikum gut an. Diesem Umstand trug Regisseurin Amy Heckerling („Clueless“) Rechnung, als sie die Story des kleinen Mikey ersann, der mal vorlaut, mal altklug die Taten der „Großen“ kommentiert. 

Die Originalversion verdankt ihren Witz zum Gutteil der Stimme von Bruce Willis, der dem Baby seine markante Röhre lieh. Für die Synchronfassung stellte Thomas Gottschalk sein Organ zur Verfügung.

programme.title: Der Typ, 13 Kinder & ich
programme.desc: Im Auftrag seines Onkels soll der notorische Single und Fabrikerbe Leon (Tim Bergmann) die widerspenstige Esther (Julia Brendler) überreden, ihr baufälliges Haus aufzugeben. Der Frauenflüsterer hat allerdings kein leichtes Spiel. Denn Esther weiß fünf eigene und acht Pflegekinder hinter sich… \r\nTim Bergmann muss hier also gleich vierzehn Neinsager entwaffnen. Und er schafft es, was kaum überraschen. Dennoch ist der Familienspaß insgesamt quirlig und amüsant inszeniert.

programme.title: Tierisch verknallt
programme.desc: Nach dem Tod seiner Frau hat Architekt Peter (Oliver Mommsen) sich zu einem mürrischen Einzelgänger entwickelt. Sein Sohn Jan (Max Boekhoff) hält das nicht mehr aus und beschließt: Papa braucht ’ne Neue. Als Lisa (Jasmin Gerat) bei ihnen einziehen will, scheint sein Plan aufzugehen. Doch Peter wimmelt sie unwirsch ab. Jetzt bittet Jan verzweifelt seine Mutter im Himmel um Hilfe. Und schwupps können die Haustiere Johnny und Paula plötzlich sprechen und holen Lisa mit einer List zurück.Peter allerdings ist davon gar nicht begeistert, vor allem als er wenig später mit ihr im Büro zusammenarbeiten soll…\r\nSchlecht computeranimierte Tiere (die Darsteller spielen auch nicht lebhafter), einfallslose Dialoge und ein vorhersehbares Ende: \r\nDieser in jedem Moment überraschungsfreie Filmist leider für die Katz.

programme.title: Im Schatten das Licht
programme.desc: Eigentlich ist Natashas (Anna Schudt) Wohnsituation kompliziert genug: Mac (Kai Schumann), baldiger Ex-Mann der Anwältin, hat sich im gemeinsamen Haus einquartiert und sorgt für Gefühlsturbulenzen. Doch als Natasha im Supermarkt erlebt, wie die Waise Sarah (Lorna zu Solms) beim Klauen erwischt wird, nimmt sie das Mädchen kurzerhand bei sich auf. Sarah hat allerdings ihren eigenen Kopf und büxt auf ihrem Pferd Boo nach Frankreich aus. Um ihren Opa stolz zu machen, will sie sich an der Reitschule Cadre d’Or bewerben… Moyes’ Roman „Im Schatten das Licht“ erschien im Original 2009, bevor die Autorin wenige Jahre später mit „Ein ganzes halbes Jahr“ die Bestsellerlisten stürmte. Doch weder die gefühlige Geschichte noch ihre Adaption durch die Grimme-preisgekrönte Regisseurin Vivian Naefe vermögen zu überzeugen: Die Verfilmung ist zu lang und zu vorhersehbar geraten – und pilchert stellenweise gewaltig.

programme.title: Mit Herz und Handschellen
programme.desc: Während sie noch immer auf der Suche nach dem Mann fürs Leben ist, hat er ihn bereits gefunden: Nina Metz und ihr Kollege Hauptkommissar Leo Kraft. Leo ist ein sensibler Mann mit viel Charme und Selbstbewusstsein und lebt seit Jahren glücklich mit dem Musiker Thorsten zusammen. Nina hingegen ist äußerst ehrgeizig, sehr direkt, launisch, aber durchaus auch humorvoll. Eine brillante Mischung aus Eigenschaften, die das Ermittler-Duo bei der Verbrecherjagd unschlagbar macht. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: MacGyver
programme.desc: Jack hat Elwood gekidnappt, um ihm das Leben zu retten: Ein Gangster, mit dem er vor seinem Sinneswandel ein Ding gedreht hat, ist hinter ihm her und will das Geld, das Elwood ihm noch schuldet. Mac versucht unterdessen vom Think Tank aus per Videoschalte der Besatzung eines Forschungsschiffes zu helfen, das in der Arktis festsitzt. Es gab einen Unfall an Bord, der Notfallgenerator springt nicht an, und die Temperaturen sinken immer weiter. Die Crew droht zu erfrieren. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Mediashop – Weil es besser geht
programme.desc: "MediaShop" bietet qualitativ hochwertige Produkte, die den Alltag erleichtern, zu einem attraktiven Preis. Nach dem Motto "Weil es besser geht" gibt es bei "MediaShop" Innovationen aus aller Welt und ein unterhaltsames Einkaufserlebnis. Das umfassende Produktportfolio beinhaltet die neuesten Produkte aus den Bereichen Küche, Haushalt, Freizeit, Fitness, Wellness und Beauty. "MediaShop" vertreibt die originalen "As seen on TV" Produkte an Millionen zufriedene Kunden. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: East New York
programme.desc: Die ehemalige Streifenpolizistin Regina Haywood steigt zum Deputy Inspector des 74. Bezirks von East New York auf. Ihr Einsatzgebiet ist ein Arbeiterviertel am Rande von Brooklyn. Regina ist selbst dort aufgewachsen und kennt die sozialen Probleme des Viertels. Mit ihrer Polizeitruppe würde sie den Bewohnern gerne auf Augenhöhe begegnen und gleichzeitig für Sicherheit sorgen. Doch dafür muss sie bei ihren Teamkollegen erst einmal viel Überzeugungsarbeit leisten ... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: MacGyver
programme.desc: Angus MacGyver, genannt Mac, ist smart, clever und ein Technik-Genie: Ihm genügen die einfachsten Mittel, um Bomben zu entschärfen, einen Fallschirm zu basteln oder einen Handflächenscanner zu überlisten. Daher steht er in Diensten einer Geheimorganisation, die für die USA weltweit brenzlige Situationen löst und üble Gangster ausschaltet. MacGyver und sein Team gehen dabei an ihre Grenzen – schließlich geht es jedes Mal um die Rettung der Welt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: MacGyver
programme.desc: Team Phoenix soll in Ecuador dafür sorgen, dass bei den anstehenden Präsidentschaftswahlen nicht Colonel Zarate an die Macht kommt, der den vorherigen Präsidenten gestürzt hat. Sein Gegenkandidat Hector León hat gute Chancen, steht aber auf Zarates Abschussliste und benötigt zudem dringend ein Spenderherz, sonst stirbt er. Mac und Jack sollen das neue Herz beschaffen, Riley und Cage müssen León sicher ins Krankenhaus transportieren. Beides ist leichter gesagt als getan ... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: MacGyver
programme.desc: Team Phoenix hat einen heiklen Auftrag: In den USA sollten 50 Kanister eines Nervengases vernichtet werden. Doch der zuständige Laborant hat sich einen Kanister abgezweigt, den er auf dem Schwarzmarkt anbietet. Mac, Jack und Cage sollen das Gas sicherstellen. Während Mac und Jack in dem Labor zugange sind, rückt ein Söldnertrupp an – geschickt von einer bekannten Terroristin. Matty beschließt, den Söldnern das Gas zu überlassen und die Verfolgung aufzunehmen ... (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Der exzentrische Engländer Sherlock Holmes hat in New York erfolgreich einen Drogenentzug absolviert und arbeitet seitdem als Berater für das NYPD. Sein Boss, Captain Tobias Gregson, fürchtet jedoch, dass Holmes' außergewöhnliche Art, Verbrechen aufzuklären, in seiner Behörde zu Problemen führen könnte. Die Ärztin Dr. Joan Watson soll den Ex-Junkie betreuen. Als sie Holmes zu seiner Arbeit begleitet, stellt sie fest, dass ihr Ermittlungsarbeit mehr liegt, als sie gedacht hat. (Senderinfo).

programme.desc: Aus politischem Kalkül wird die 14-jährige österreichische Prinzessin Marie Antoinette mit dem französischen Thronfolger Ludwig XVI. verheiratet. Fred Dibnah's Magnificent Monuments
programme.desc: Fred Dibnah tours across Britain in this fascinating documentary series to examine the country's most spectacular marvels of engineering. Each episode in the six-part series follows Fred as he unravels the history behind a respective monument or structure, detailing each projects development and the innovative minds that brought them to life. A compelling examination of some of Britain's grandest monuments including Edinburgh Castle, Hampton Court Palace, St Paul's Cathedral, Chatham's historic dockyard, the Channel Tunnel, and Blackpool Tower, with each episode centering on a different theme. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: War Walks
programme.desc: Join Professor Richard Holmes as he traverses the routes, roads, beaches and bunkers of historic battles that have taken place across Europe. The British military historian shares his knowledge and passion of these destructive events, venturing to battle locations and immersing himself in the stories that surround the fighting. Professor Holmes describes in great detail the events that led to these monumental clashes, as well as the corresponding aftermaths that followed. From Agincourt to Waterloo, The Somme to Hastings and Dunkirk to Naseby, we learn of the devastation these battles caused. The series was originally broadcast from 1996 to 1997. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: A Wild Year
programme.sub-title: The Pembrokeshire Coast: A Wild Year
programme.desc: Documentary series perusing the wonders of three natural areas in Britain, the Pembrokeshire Coast, the Fens of East Anglia, and the North York Moors, with each region examined over the course of a year in its own respective episode. Dive into the emboldening beauty of each unique environment, explore the stunning wildlife that inhabits each landscape, and follow the changing of the seasons that brings new life to each picturesque location. A series worthy of the regions it examines; this is A Wild Year. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Magnificent Monuments
programme.desc: From early stone circles to great cathedrals, Fred travels around Britain tracing the development of our places of worship. He begins his journey in Preston, where Fred is repairing the tallest church steeple in Britain, while in County Durham he discovers a Saxon church built from the remains of an abandoned Roman Fort. At St Paul's Cathedral he finds out how the dome is kept in shape and then joins the stone masons to help with their restoration work at York Minster. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Battle of the River Plate
Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy
programme.desc:
„Ein Mann sollte wissen, wann es Zeit ist, die Party zu verlassen.“ Als 1973 ein von ihm beauftragter Sonderauftrag in Budapest schiefläuft, quittiert der britische Geheimdienstchef „Control“ (John Hurt) den Dienst. Seinen Vize George Smiley (Gary Oldman) beordert er gleich mit in den Ruhestand. 

Schon kurze Zeit später erhält Smiley von höchster Staatsebene einen brisanten Auftrag: An der Spitze des Circus, wie der Geheimdienst intern genannt wird, soll es einen Maulwurf geben, der die sowjetische Gegenseite mit Informationen versorgt. Offenbar suchte bereits der inzwischen verstorbene Control den „faulen Apfel“. 

Unterstützt vom jungen Geheimdienstler Peter Guillam („Sherlock“ Benedict Cumberbatch) nimmt Smiley seine alten Kollegen Haydon (Colin Firth), Bland, Esterhase und den zum Leiter aufgestiegenen Alleline (Toby Jones) unter die Lupe. In Controls Wohnung entdecken beide Schachfiguren, die mit Fotos der vier beklebt wurden – aber auch eine „Dame“ mit einem Foto von Smiley…

Glamour, actionreiche Verfolgungsjagden und exotische Landschaften darf der Zuschauende hier nicht erwarten: Der schwedische Regisseur Tomas Alfredson („So finster die Nacht“) inszeniert John le Carrés Roman über weite Strecken kammerspielartig als triste Agentenwelt, deren Akteure ihre Ideale lange verloren haben. 

Die vielen (fast ausnahmslos männlichen) Figuren, aber auch die zahlreichen Rückblenden und Zeitsprünge erfordern dabei höchste Konzentration beim Zuschauenden. Der wird mit einem hoch spannenden, subtilen Katz-und-Maus-Spiel belohnt, großartigen Darstellern, exquisiten, detailgenauen Settings und einem atmosphärischen Soundtrack.

programme.title: Mark Kermode's Secrets of Cinema
programme.desc: Mark Kermode explores one of the most distinctive and popular genres of all. The spy movie plays on our paranoia and feeds our fears as well as fulfilling our fantasies of secret missions and special skills. It has also given us perhaps the most famous hero in all of cinema – James Bond. Spy movies capture a world not of black and white but shades of grey. But if the morality is often ambiguous, the genre is full of tried and tested conventions. Mark opens up the cinematic agent's essential toolkit, from the spy boss to the mysterious McGuffin, surveillance techniques to a striking set of opening titles, and he traces the development of the genre from its earliest days. Whether you're a blockbuster superspy or a compromised cold warrior, Mark reveals all you need to survive in the murky yet thrilling world of big screen espionage. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: In Conversation
programme.sub-title: Ken Loach in Conversation with Cillian Murphy
programme.desc: Actors and directors talk about their careers with fellow artists and contemporaries. Actor Cillian Murphy, who played the lead role in Ken Loach's Palme d'Or-winning film The Wind That Shakes the Barley, talks to the director about a prolific career dedicated to documenting social and political injustice, the importance of artistic collaboration, the often-overlooked humour in Loach's films, and the impact working with Loach had on his own approach to acting. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Timeshift
programme.desc: To mark 100 years of romance publishers Mills and Boon, literary novelist Stella Duffy takes on the challenge of writing for them. Romantic fiction is a global phenomenon, and Mills and Boon are among the biggest names in the business. The company welcomes submissions from new authors, but as Duffy soon finds out, writing a Mills and Boon is harder than it looks. Help is at hand from the publishers themselves, a prolific Mills and Boon author and some avid romance fans, as Duffy's quest to create the perfect romantic novel takes her from London to Italy on a journey that is both an insight into the art of romantic fiction and the joy and frustration of writing itself. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Top of the Pops
programme.desc: Travel back in time with a compilation of legendary performances of classic acts straight from the archive of one of the most popular music chart shows in history. Top of the Pops was broadcast weekly from 1964 until 2006, welcoming the greatest stars who performed their biggest hits. This special brings you unforgettable musical moments of pop and rock icons like The Rolling Stones, The Beatles, David Bowie, The Who, The Clash, Blur, Oasis and many more. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Girls in Bands at the BBC
programme.desc: This compilation celebrates some guitar-band performances at the BBC that feature some of the best female musicians in rock. Beginning with the oft-forgotten American group Fanny performing You're The One it's a journey along rock's spectrum from 1970s to now. The selection includes the powerful vocals of Elkie Brooks on Vinegar Joe's Proud To Be A Honky Tonk Woman, the mesmerising poetry of Patti Smith's Horses and upbeat energy of The Go-Go's on We Got The Beat.Mighty basslines come courtesy of Tina Weymouth on Psycho Killer and Kim Gordon on Sugar Kane, whilst we trace the line of indie rock from The Au Pairs through Lush, Elastica and Garbage to current band Savages. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Fanny: The Right to Rock
programme.desc: The untold story of a California garage band, co-founded in the 1960s by Filipina American and queer teenagers, which morphed into the ferocious rock group Fanny, the first all-female band to release an LP with a major record label (Warner/Reprise, 1970). Despite releasing Top 40 hits and five critically acclaimed albums between 1970 to 1974, counting David Bowie as one of their most vocal fans and touring extensively with bands like Chicago, Steely Dan, Slade and other major groups, Fanny's groundbreaking impact in music has been lost in the mists of time... until bandmates reunite 50 years later with a new rock record deal and a chance to right the wrongs of history. Fanny's brave present-day journey and fascinating backstory is illuminated by rare performance archival footage, photography and celebrity interviews with music legends including Bonnie Raitt, Todd Rundgren, The Go Go's Kathy Valentine, The Runaways' Cherie Currie, The B52's Kate Pierson, Lovin' Spoonful's John Sebastien, Def Leppard's Joe Elliott, David Bowie's guitarist Earl Slick and bassist Gail Ann Dorsey, Charles Neville and Steely Dan's Jeff 'Skunk' Baxter. Fanny blasted glass ceilings of racism and sexism back in the 1960s and 70s, with the lesbian bandmates told to either hide their LBGTQ identity or leave the band, and with their new album, these feisty women, now in their 70s, challenge the stigma of ageism as well. Through the captivating lens of rock 'n' roll, this film raises critical questions about identity, perseverance, love, family and the elusive alchemy of pursuing the American Dream. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Weather For the Week Ahead
programme.desc: Detailed weather report. Bringing you details of current weather conditions for across the UK and what to expect for the next seven days. With forecasts, temperatures and weather warnings. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: The latest news from the BBC,which is designed to inform you on current affairs. The BBC is aims to be a totally impartial public service broadcaster, and was established by Royal Charter. The BBC is funded by a licence fee paid by British households, and is regulated by Ofcom. They aim to create high-quality content, in order to inform and educate, but also entertain, their audience Millions of people from all over the world watch content produced by the BBC, and they are well respected as a media company. It was founded in 1922, with its headquarters in Westminster, London. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Breakfast
programme.desc: BBC One's flagship morning current affairs programme with news headlines and regular weather reports. Start your day with the biggest national and international stories. Breakfast takes a look at the day's papers and brings you the latest developments in sports, politics, business and entertainment. Breakfast welcomes guests to the studio for a chat. Whilst analysis and special reports offer a greater understanding of important subjects. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Morning Live
programme.desc: Morning show discussing key topics of conversation of the previous week. The best start of Sunday: lively chat about social and religious issues, and highlights of extraordinary stories of ordinary people. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Learn the tricks of the trade when you go to the auctions with Homes Under the Hammer. Join presenters Martin Roberts, Dion Dublin and Martel Maxwell as they follow the renovation stories of properties across Britain as they get transformed from empty shells and outdated buildings to desirable spaces and contemporary homes. Watch as ordinary people breathe new life into the otherwise unloved houses, and find out how well they managed to stay within budget. Will they sell and make a profit, or have they invested too much money in a project that wont sell? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Today's show comes from a bustling antiques fair in Detling in Kent, where two teams browse jam-packed stalls with the aim of buying three items in an hour to take to auction. The red team, friends Bill and Al, known as Del Boy and Rodney to their friends, are led around by expert Catherine Southon, while the blues, performing arts teachers Jo and Simisola, are treated to the dry wit of expert Mark Stacey. Both teams browse a variety of items, but whereas the blues finish with enough time to grab a cuppa, the reds take it right to the wire. With the seconds counting down, Bill, Al and Catherine desperately try to find their third item. Will they do a deal in time? Presenter Eric Knowles visits the Kent Museum of the Moving Image to learn about peep boxes and magic lanterns, two early forms of visual entertainment that delighted audiences as far back as the 17th century. Over in Portsmouth, auctioneer Daniel Tricker is doing the business on the rostrum. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: BBC News at One
programme.desc: Early afternoon round-up of the day's biggest national and international stories. The BBC News Team bring you the headlines and essential up-to-the-minute information about the latest developments. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Money for Nothing
programme.desc: JJ Chalmers is at Wallyford recycling centre on Scotland's east coast hoping to uncover three lucrative items amongst the skip-bound trash. He enlists the help of signwriter Joel Poole for a creative design on a glass-fronted cabinet, whilst upcycler Sarah Peterson turns her attention to a radical makeover on an old wicker trunk. Meanwhile, JJ sets himself the challenge of turning a pair of wooden doors into a potential profit. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Push factors from the noisy, bustling cities of Britain, combined with the alluring peace of the countryside, has the population dreaming of homes in more scenic surroundings. Escape to the Country sees buyers from different areas on the UK considering their options to settle down in the English countryside. Presenters show off a range of prospective homes, before they must make their final decision towards the end of the show. Each episode taking place in a different region of the UK, we see a wide variety of beautiful homes across the country. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Bidding Room
programme.desc: Interesting docu-reality show, hosted by English actor and presenter Nigel Havers, in which a panel of dealers provide expert advice and buy off various antique and collectable items brought in by members of the public. Nigel welcomes people who have intriguing, often peculiar and extraordinary items they want to sell- anything from toys and furniture to musical instruments, and introduces them to an expert who provides them with some information about the object. Sellers then go to the ''Bidding room'' where they meet five dealers who have to bid against each other if they want to take home these incredible items. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the quiz show where a team of four – in this episode, friends Ollie, Gus, Benjy and Joe – take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money. Step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Pointless
programme.desc: The high pressure game show, where pointless answers are the way to win. Contestants not only have to answer questions correctly, but give the answer that scores the least points. They do this by coming up with the least obvious answers, that other people struggle to come up with in a survey of individuals. A correct answer that nobody else managed to say is a pointless answer, the best possible outcome. A pointless answer in the final round is how you win the jackpot, cash prize, which grows with every episode until someone wins. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The One Show
programme.desc: A show with big-name guests and special reports on a range of subjects including consumer rights, current affairs and contemporary issues. The One Show looks at topics from the quirky and rare to much more serious matters. Since first hitting British screens in 2006, The One Show has welcomed hundreds of celebrities to its sofa. With high-profile from stage, screen, sport, music, politics and more; including then-British-Prime Minister Theresa May, Daniel Radcliffe, Dame Judy Dench, Sir Tom Jones and many, many more. With fun, laughs and the occasional musical number. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: EastEnders
programme.desc: EastEnders is a series set in Albert Square in the East End of London in the fictional Borough of Walford. Here respectable townhouses are next to offices and apartments. We follow everyday stories of local residents and their families. The locals live their ordinary lives- go to night clubs, markets, pubs and cafes. They fall in love and fight, get sick, get divorced. Kids can break a window, neighbors can pick a fight. There is nothing extraordinary but life in the East End is full of various moments of fun. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Shetland
programme.desc: Based on the novels by Anne Cleeves, Shetland is a crime-drama series starring Douglas Henshall as Detective Inspector Jimmy Perez, the lead investigator on the Shetland Islands off the coast of Scotland. Alongside his team of experts, DI Perez attempts to solve the crimes causing concern amongst the tight-knit communities of Shetland. The BBC drama series was adapted for the screen by writer David Kane and, alongside Henshall, features performances from Alison O'Donnell, Steven Robertson, Lewis Howden and Stewart Porter. The show has also been attributed as a major boost in tourism on the islands. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Morning Live
programme.desc: Morning show discussing key topics of conversation of the previous week. The best start of Sunday: lively chat about social and religious issues, and highlights of extraordinary stories of ordinary people. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: Learn the tricks of the trade when you go to the auctions with Homes Under the Hammer. Join presenters Martin Roberts, Dion Dublin and Martel Maxwell as they follow the renovation stories of properties across Britain as they get transformed from empty shells and outdated buildings to desirable spaces and contemporary homes. Watch as ordinary people breathe new life into the otherwise unloved houses, and find out how well they managed to stay within budget. Will they sell and make a profit, or have they invested too much money in a project that wont sell? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bargain Hunt: Children in Need
programme.desc: Two teams of amateur collectors meet at an antiques fair to compete to turn in the largest profit from a £300 budget. The teams receive guidance from expert traders, who give feedback on which items are most likely to attract the highest bids. The contestants first head to the High Street to acquire items they want to trade. Any leftover money is taken by their mentors, who go shopping for extra items as 'bonus buys'. The teams must decide which 'package' of goodies should be taken to auction, on the understanding that they may turn in a profit or loss on their investment decisions. The show has been on air since March 2000, being voted Most Popular Daytime Programme in 2002 and Best Lifestyle Show in 2003. It was also nominated for Most Popular Factual Entertainment Programme in 2003. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: BBC News at One
programme.desc: Early afternoon round-up of the day's biggest national and international stories. The BBC News Team bring you the headlines and essential up-to-the-minute information about the latest developments. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Escape to the Country
programme.desc: Push factors from the noisy, bustling cities of Britain, combined with the alluring peace of the countryside, has the population dreaming of homes in more scenic surroundings. Escape to the Country sees buyers from different areas on the UK considering their options to settle down in the English countryside. Presenters show off a range of prospective homes, before they must make their final decision towards the end of the show. Each episode taking place in a different region of the UK, we see a wide variety of beautiful homes across the country. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Bidding Room
programme.sub-title: Lighthouse Cocktail Shaker, Cigar Cutters, Jade Disc
programme.desc: Looking to mix things up is Sarah, bearing an impressive silver-plated lighthouse-shaped cocktail shaker. She's brought her own Elvis impersonator to woo the dealers, but she might get even more help from our very own Nigel Havers. Jason continues to bring the bling, with a uranium glass jewellery set that radiates class. He clearly has a great eye, but will the dealers share his taste? Third to face the dealers is Kamran from Bradford. He's got a papal artifact he found in the attic, and backed up by some diligent research, he's looking to move it on. Clayton doesn't know much about his jade disc, but that just means it might be a sleeper hit. So, will he be able to earn a pretty penny on this charity shop find? Smoking may be bad for your health, but selling smoking memorabilia can be good for your bank balance. Danni's stylish cigar cutters certainly fit the bill, but the buyers will have to work hard, as she won't let them go for a snip. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Celebrity Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents this high-stakes quiz as a team of soap stars, featuring EastEnder Danielle Harold, Hollyoaks's Lucy-Jo Hudson, Coronation Street's Simon Gregson and Emmerdale's Chris Bisson, get together to take on the Bridge of Lies for their chosen charities. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each bridge crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and 10 lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money, step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge, they just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash for their chosen charities. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Pointless
programme.desc: The high pressure game show, where pointless answers are the way to win. Contestants not only have to answer questions correctly, but give the answer that scores the least points. They do this by coming up with the least obvious answers, that other people struggle to come up with in a survey of individuals. A correct answer that nobody else managed to say is a pointless answer, the best possible outcome. A pointless answer in the final round is how you win the jackpot, cash prize, which grows with every episode until someone wins. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Graham Norton Show
programme.desc: Graham Norton plays host to his celebrity guests, who are invited to chat, play games and give an insider view on stories that grab the public's attention, especially within the world of entertainment. International stars of the calibre of Tom Cruise, Tom Hanks and Will Smith have joined in the fun, but whether the guests are top league or minor list celebs, the interview couch is never short of a little star voltage, or a cheeky story or two to keep viewers enthralled. The critics have awarded Graham with the gold standard of talk shows, and there's nothing that he is not prepared to discuss with his VIP interviewees. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Film: The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes
programme.desc:
Der junge Coriolanus Snow wird mit 23 Mitschülern an der Akademie des Kapitols zu den ersten Mentoren der Hungerspiele ernannt. Um sich die Chance auf ein begehrtes Stipendium zu sichern, muss er den Auftritt seines Tributs – die Wandermusikerin Lucy Gray Baird aus Distrikt 12 – bei den zehnten Hungerspielen zu einem Spektakel machen. 

Die durch den Krieg gegen die Rebellen verarmte Familie Snow droht sonst in die Bedeutungslosigkeit abzurutschen. Coriolanus’ unbändiger Ehrgeiz und die aufkeimenden Gefühle für Lucy Gray treiben ihn an, alles aufs Spiel zu setzen… 

Wie wurde Präsident Snow zu dem Tyrannen, den wir aus der „Die Tribute von Panem“-Reihe (2012–2015) kennen, der darin von Donald Sutherland gespielt wurde? Francis Lawrence, Regisseur der Filme ab „Catching Fire“ (2013), geht dieser Frage im Prequel getreu der Romanvorlage „Das Lied von Vogel und Schlange“ (2020) von Suzanne Collins nach. Die fabelhaft ausgestattete Dystopie erzählt ein neues Kapitel Panems, das sich im Ton und inhaltlich von den Vorgängern erheblich unterscheidet. So bietet das Prequel eine frische Ergänzung zum Franchise, die zur spannenden Charakterstudie um den jungen Snow wird. 

Leider geht bei dessen Entwicklung im Gegensatz zur Vorlage etwas Tiefe verloren. Trotzdem gelingt die Rückkehr nach Panem auch dank der starken Hauptdarsteller Tom Blyth (Snow) und Rachel Zegler (Lucy Gray).

programme.title: MasterChef: The Professionals
programme.desc: The remaining five chefs return to the kitchen for two demanding challenges that will push their skills, creativity and ambition to the limit as they battle for a place in the quarter-final. Monica and Marcus are joined by special guest chef and Mexican maestro Santiago Lastra, who sets the chefs one of his most complex dishes to date: honey and chilli char-glazed duck breast, served with mole, a rich, deeply layered Mexican sauce, packed with toasted spices, dried chillies and layers of flavour. But Santiago isn't looking for a faithful recreation. He wants the chefs to take his dish as inspiration and make it their own. With the chef who impresses most earning a straight passage to the quarter-final, the stakes couldn't be higher. Some chefs push their creativity in bold new directions, while others struggle to match the precision and depth of flavour Santiago demands. Then there's one final chance to secure their place in the quarter-final as they take on the signature dessert challenge. Often overlooked, pastry demands a different kind of precision where technique, timing and attention to detail are everything. With just one place separating success from elimination, Monica and Marcus expect the chefs to showcase their flair and individuality on the plate. With the competition closer than ever, who has done enough to stay in the race? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: Sitting between Germany and France, Alsace is frontier land with a cuisine to match. In Strasbourg, Eva stops off at Brasserie Le Tigre for a beer (brassier means 'to brew') and a deliciously creamy tarte flambee. Then there's a trip to guide Coralie Andt's restaurant, known as a winstub, where French wines can be enjoyed with plenty of cheese and sausage – as well as more sausage with sauerkraut cooked in white Riesling wine. With French tarts in a brasserie that serves German-style beer, and German sausage in a winstub serving French white wine, Alsace is defined by its competing national influences. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Wooden shoe lasts are a common sight at antiques fairs, but do you know how they're made? Natasha Raskin Sharp visits the workshop of cordwainer Payson Muller, originally a stonemason, who turned his talents to making bespoke shoes on hand-carved shoe lasts. He creates them from beech boughs before refining their shape using a knife and rasp. Hoping to cut a few deals of their own are two teams of bargain hunters, shopping for collectibles at Wetherby Racecourse. In blue are couple Martin and Nasreen, and their opponents are married duo Lisamarie and Jamie. Nasreen's keen eye spots an ornate Russian caviar bowl and spoon, but the price tag is an eye-watering £600. Elsewhere, Jamie comes across a wacky glass vase that resembles a famous artist's work, but Philip Serrell thinks it's no masterpiece. At the sale, both teams hope for big profits, but all they can do is watch as their items go under auctioneer Caroline Hawley's hammer. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: It's the end of an era on Gardeners' World as Monty approaches his final programme from Longmeadow, the garden he has shared with the nation for the last 16 years. With Ned by his side, he celebrates the enduring pleasures of gardening and serves up one last bulb lasagne. Autumn is a busy time with vegetables to sow, perennials to plant and windfall apples to collect. Carol Klein takes a deep dive into the scientific world of plants. This time, it's all about the magical properties of their shoots. Joe Swift visits close friend and garden designer Ann-Marie Powell to explore her own garden, a place that has become her solace since the death of her husband last year. In North Yorkshire, there's a remarkable, pioneering woman on a quest to grow thousands of trees from seed. And a couple in East Grinstead share their combined love for the garden they have created together. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: Game show in which 24 players compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day. In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Answer Run
programme.desc: Comedian Jason Manford hosts an exciting, fast-paced quiz show, where three couples face a series of 50/50 questions which hurtle The Answer Run down towards them. Across three rounds, the couples build up their cash pots, but only one pair can face The Final Run and win the chance to take home their cash prize. Who will swipe their way to victory? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Beechgrove Repotted
programme.desc: George Anderson goes back to school, Flower School, to learn how to make a unique, living flower wreath. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Film: The Battle Of the River Plate
programme.desc: Second World War naval adventure based on the true story of the pursuit of the seemingly unstoppable German battleship Graf Spee. Allied forces chase the vessel all the way to South America, but after several failed attempts to sink the enemy ship, the Allies find themselves hatching a desperate and audacious plan. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team step back in time at the Beamish Open Air Museum near Newcastle. Amongst the items brought to light are a rare rapier sword allegedly smuggled out of Russia in the props box of the Bolshoi Ballet. We meet a keen collector of battlefield finds known as trench art, and the finest music box to appear on the Roadshow is valued. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: This episode comes from the place sometimes dubbed "the last bastion of free speech in the western world" – the historic Oxford Union. Paul Martin is joined by experts Christina Trevanion and Mark Stacey. Together the team pick out a selection of interesting antiques and collectables to be sold at the local auction house. Christina uncovers a famous fake while Mark gets a religious education after discovering a rare Baptist bust. Paul delves into the history of the auction site which is built on top of infamous Greenham Common. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: New: House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Dame Laura Kenny, Minah Shannon, Seann Walsh and Ricky Wilson take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games decanter, or will they be tempted with the House of Games record player? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Strictly It Takes Two
programme.desc: Ellie Taylor serves up more unmissable action from the world of Strictly as she chats to more couples about their weekend preparations. Also, costume designer Vicky Gill gives an exclusive look at some of her newest creations. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Humanity's very survival depends on water. But global reserves are rapidly shrinking with no end in sight thanks to unmitigated climate change, population growth and poor resource management. Over two-thirds of the global population are faced with water stress, while millions have already been displaced by intense water scarcity which is now replacing oil as the most likely cause of global conflict. Hannah Fry learns about the different ways in which technology could help secure humanity's future water needs. She witnesses the effects of water scarcity in Kenya and learns about how technological solutions are currently being harnessed to reverse this dire situation. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Secret Genius of Modern Life: The Best Bits.
programme.desc: Fridges have been quietly "keeping things cool" in the kitchen for over 100 years, and yet most of us barely give them a second thought. Hannah hits the production line with appliance giants Bosch to find the lifeblood at the heart of every fridge and gets a lesson in carrot droop. And she takes a long, cool look at the fridge's history to reveal how a French monk with a flair for chemistry, a 17th century chicken incubator and an explosive invention in Australia created the ultimate chill. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don explores the most densely populated part of the country, London and the home counties. He visits some of London's gardens, including a special one on a barge, as well as a beautifully restored garden close to where he grew up in Hampshire and some gardens known for their different and personal styles of planting. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Rise of the Rockstar Chef
programme.desc: Every chef dreams of a Michelin star. Episode two of Rise of the Rockstar Chef follows the hunt for that recognition, and for the leap that separates the great from the legendary. Moving from one star to two is hard, but the hardest jump of all is from two to three. Marco Pierre White made that leap, becoming the first British chef to win three Michelin stars, and the youngest ever to do so. The episode explores what the pursuit demanded and what it cost. Marco reflects on the price of perfection. and how success also brings a rupture. Gordon Ramsay, who learned his craft under Marco, leaves to build his own name, and both men look back on the emotion of that parting. When menus from Aubergine begin appearing on Marco's desk, the friendship is over. Gordon recounts the story of the stealing of the restaurant's reservation book, the crown jewels of any restaurant, revealing just how bitter the split became. Marcus Wareing, Gordon's first employee, recalls the early days of Gordon's kitchen and the fierce ambition driving it. As the 90s unfold, Heston Blumenthal's drive, creativity and uncompromising pursuit of excellence transforms modern British cuisine. Heston cooks in a completely different way, and his food blows minds. It is pure theatre, with equipment unlike anything seen in a normal kitchen. Dishes such as the triple-cooked chip, taking two years to perfect, went on to change not just food but kitchens in restaurants and at home. With the opening of The Fat Duck, his home is on the line, and the need for success is huge. Meanwhile, the empires expand. Marco and Gordon take over the kitchens of some of London's top hotels, and their restaurants become the places to be. Marco's restaurant Titanic draws the Spice Girls, Oasis, footballers and the tabloids, with as many as 4,000 guests passing through in a single night – a 90s Studio 54. Contributors describe the energy of those years, and the revolutionary push for creativity in ways never seen before. When Heston is crowned the number one chef in the world, he voices the immensity of the pressure, his inferiority complex and the highs and lows of extreme success. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Cunk on Cinema
programme.desc: Philomena Cunk's groundbreaking history of cinema begins. Cunk meets Hollywood legends and interrogates the writer of Die Hard, as she starts her quest deep, deep into cinema. She witnesses the shockingly poor picture quality of the earliest films and marvels at the beards of their Victorian inventors; she gasps audibly at the invention of sound; and she critiques some of the supposedly finest creations of Hollywood's Golden Age. Along the way she interviews filmmakers, actors and critics, including several you've definitely heard of, and she (and you) finally discovers the true meaning of The Wizard of Oz. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Film: Hell or High Water
programme.desc:
Sie haben nichts mehr zu verlieren: Die Brüder Toby (Chris Pine) und Tanner (Ben Foster) rauben in der texanischen Provinz Banken aus, um ihre verpfändete Farm zu retten. Gleich die erste Einstellung gibt den melancholischen Grundton des Films vor. 

Die Kamera streift durch die verlassenen Straßen einer Kleinstadt, vorbei an den Wänden einer Bank, auf die jemand geschrieben hat: „Drei Einsätze im Irak, aber für Leute wie uns gibt es keinen Kredit.“ Wenn Toby und Tanner auf ihren immer gewagteren Raubzügen durch West Texas fahren, durchqueren sie ein Land, das von Niedergang und Verfall gezeichnet ist. 

Nur die Banken streichen noch Profit ein. Und den holen sich Toby und Tanner zurück. Verfolgt werden die Brüder von Texas Ranger Hamilton (Jeff Bridges)… 

Ein Abgesang auf Amerika.

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: With the promise of unimaginable computing power, a global race for quantum supremacy is raging. Hannah Fry looks inside the IBM research facility, one of the oldest tech companies in the world, to uncover the future of quantum technology. She explores the unprecedented potential of quantum computing and how precarious this advanced power may be in the wrong hands. Through her exclusive interviews with world-class experts in quantum technologies, Hannah explores the international quantum arms race between the US and China. She breaks down the implications of this 21st-century race and how a quantum future could change the very nature of humanity. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Humanity's very survival depends on water. But global reserves are rapidly shrinking with no end in sight thanks to unmitigated climate change, population growth and poor resource management. Over two-thirds of the global population are faced with water stress, while millions have already been displaced by intense water scarcity which is now replacing oil as the most likely cause of global conflict. Hannah Fry learns about the different ways in which technology could help secure humanity's future water needs. She witnesses the effects of water scarcity in Kenya and learns about how technological solutions are currently being harnessed to reverse this dire situation. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: MasterChef: The Professionals
programme.desc: It's the first quarter-final, and the four chefs who have fought their way through the heats return to the kitchen with everything to play for. Their next challenge is to prove that they can raise their game once again as they battle for one of just 12 places in knockout week. The competition is about to get serious. First up, the chefs face the invention test. Under their mystery boxes on their benches is a surprise key ingredient that must take centre stage in their dish – coconut, an ingredient that can bring richness, sweetness and depth, but one that demands balance and precision to get right. The larder is packed with an impressive assortment of ingredients, from fish and chocolate to an array of pastry, giving the chefs endless possibilities to make the coconut sing. But the challenge doesn't end there. The chefs must cook for two of the country's most discerning food critics, William Sitwell and Xanthe Clay, alongside new face, chef and writer Rahel Stephanie. Each chef must deliver their best two-course meal, showcasing originality and technical skill. With the standard higher than ever, every plate needs to make an impression. With their verdicts in, Monica and Marcus must make the final call. For some chefs, the critics' reactions could strengthen their case; for others, they could expose the smallest weaknesses. With only three places in knockout week up for grabs, who has done enough to stay in the competition, and whose MasterChef journey ends here? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: John Simpson – 60 Years at the BBC
programme.desc: John Simpson looks back at his extraordinary 60-year career at the BBC – reporting on the biggest global stories of the era. In a frank, personal and revealing documentary, he reflects on the changing world he has witnessed: the revolution in Iran that seemed destined to fail, his brutal kidnapping in Beirut, the fall of the Berlin Wall, two wars in Iraq, the invasion of Afghanistan and a mind-altering trip up the Amazon. From the Broadcasting House newsroom in 1966 to World Affairs editor, he looks back at memorable encounters with inspiring leaders and cruel dictators – the figures who have shaped history, including Nelson Mandela, Margaret Thatcher, Saddam Hussein, Colonel Gaddafi and Volodymyr Zelensky. The programme also features his insights into the role of the BBC today and the challenges faced in the age of fake news. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: A developer in East Sussex wants to add an extra floor onto a three-storey building, but will he be successful? A mum of four is tackling a project in Dorset with the help of relatives. Another family affair in Derbyshire involves sorting out some serious-looking cracks. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing.
programme.desc: Paul and Bob venture to the northernmost reaches of the UK – Shetland – to fish the lochs and the seas of this remote and beautiful place for trout and pollock. Shetland is an archipelago of about 100 islands off the north east coast of Scotland, only around 15 of which are inhabited. It feels like they have entered a very different world – and it's full of surprises for both of them. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: The Future with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Bioacoustics technology and AI have allowed scientists to not only decode complex animal sound data but also begin communicating with animals. While this may mean the salvation of countless animal species, the advent of inter-species communication could also have far-reaching risks for the ecosystem. In her quest to learn about the current state of animal communication, Professor Hannah Fry travels across the world, meeting Cash the talking dog in California and deciphering elephant rumbles in Nairobi. She looks into the question of whether the emerging ability to communicate with animals is one that should be exploited. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Beechgrove Repotted
programme.desc: Calum Clunie has been growing for the Fife veg and flower shows since he was 15 years old, and now he has an allotment in Leven that has dedicated to growing the largest leeks and most dazzling dahlias. Throughout a growing season, Calum let us in on his show-growing secrets as he grows giant onions and massive cabbages alongside stunning sweet peas and delightful dahlias. As a fitting end to the growing year, Calum hosts his own homegrown show in his grandparent's back garden. It's a real family affair, and there is a visit from a special surprise judge. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Film: Angels One-Five
programme.desc: Second World War drama relating the Battle of Britain through the eyes of the operations room of a Kent fighter station during the summer of 1940. A young, inexperienced pilot has trouble settling into the routine of squadron life, and his adherence to the rule book puts him out of favour with his comrades. Can he win them round? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Vintage Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel and the team enter Border country as the Roadshow visits Manderston, near Berwick-upon-Tweed. Amongst the items featured are pieces from Queen Victoria's household, a gruesome man trap and Lord Palmer's collection of rare biscuit tins. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Flog It! comes from Rochester Cathedral in Kent. Antiques expert Elizabeth Talbot falls for a book of fairy tales illustrated by Arthur Rackham, and Adam Partridge discovers an elegant chiming Swiss pocket watch. Presenter Paul Martin meets one of the last remaining survivors of the Dunkirk evacuation during the Second World War. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: New: House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Dame Laura Kenny, Minah Shannon, Seann Walsh and Ricky Wilson take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games decanter, or will they be tempted with the House of Games record player? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: International Football: Scotland v North Macedonia.
Film: Die Hard with a Vengeance
programme.desc: Ein Bombenleger hält die New Yorker Polizei auf Trab. Besonders auf John McClane (Bruce Willis) hat es der Irre abgesehen. Mit Ratespielchen hetzt Simon Gruber (Jeremy Irons) McClane kreuz und quer durch die Stadt und nutzt die allgemeine Verwirrung, um in aller Seelenruhe die Goldreserven der US-Notenbank auszuräumen. Doch er hat nicht mit der Cleverness von McClane und dessen unfreiwilligem Partner Zeus (Samuel L. Jackson) gerechnet… \n\nNachdem er bei Teil zwei pausiert hatte, übernahm wieder John McTiernan das Ruder und riss es scharf herum: Nach den klaustrophobischen Schlachtfeldern von Teil 1 und 2 wird nun eine ganze Stadt zum „Abenteuerspielplatz“. Auch dass Bruce Willis nicht mehr Einzelkämpfer ist, überraschte die Fans. Genial ist Jeremy Irons, der mit diabolischer Freude den Bösewicht gibt.

programme.title: Film: Blue Story
programme.desc: Obwohl ihre älteren Brüder zu rivalisierenden Londoner Gangs gehören, sind die Schüler Timmy (Stephen Odubola) und Marco (Micheal Ward) eng befreundet. Doch es ist nur eine Frage der Zeit, bis auch sie in den brutalen Bandenkrieg hineingezogen werden.\n„Blue Story“, das Regiedebüt des britischen Rappers ­Andrew Onwubolu, der sich selbst Rapman nennt, basiert auf der dreiteiligen YouTube-Serie „Shiro’s Story“. Rapman, der sporadisch als musikalischer Erzähler auftritt, gewährt den Zuschauern mit seinen Raptexten einen unverfälschten Einblick in die Gedankenwelt der beiden Protagonisten, die sich zu erbitterten Feinden entwickeln. Die atemlose Inszenierung verleiht den Ereignissen ein hohes Maß an Authentizität. Dazu tragen auch die lokalen Dialekte bei (weshalb auch die englische Fassung nur mit Untertiteln gezeigt wird). Mit ihrem Charisma haben die beiden Hauptdarsteller entscheidenden Anteil an der elektrisierenden Wirkung, die der Film entfaltet. Auf imposante Weise wandelt sich Stephen Odubola als Timmy vom sanften Teenager zum skrupellosen Gangster. Es gibt Momente im Film, in denen man ihn kaum wiedererkennt. \nDass es bei Kinovorstellungen in London vereinzelt zu gewaltsamen Auseinandersetzungen kam, zeigt, wie sehr die Ereignisse im Film der Realität entsprechen. Rapman lässt dennoch keinen Zweifel daran, dass sich die Gang­mitglieder in einem sinnlos erscheinenden Teufelskreis befinden, der ständig neue Opfer fordert.

programme.title: This City Is Ours
programme.desc: Desperate to recover their losses, the Phelans strike a deal with Ozzie Thompson. At Jamie and Melissa's engagement party, Michael and Diana attempt to broker peace with the family. Meanwhile, Freddie spirals further out of Michael's control. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: Hollywood legend Bill Murray begins a journey around Ireland, combining golf with a search for his Irish roots. But travelling with Bill rarely goes to plan. In Kinsale, chance encounters turn a simple walk into an adventure, while friend and golf writer Tom Coyne tries to keep things on track. Golf brought Bill to Ireland, but the best moments often happen far from the course. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Fire and Floods: Our Extreme Weather.
programme.desc: Whether you were wading through floods or struggling through a heatwave, 2026 was the year when you could hardly miss our extreme weather. Temperatures in the summer topped 30C for 33 days in a row. Months earlier, some parts of the UK saw 40 consecutive days of rain. The BBC's climate editor Justin Rowlatt investigates the impact of climate change on our weather. He speaks to scientists who warn that hotter summers and wetter winters are likely to become more typical, and looks at if enough is being done to adapt our towns and cities to the changing climate. Justin asks, as the cost of living continues to bite, are governments under pressure to ditch some green policies, or do they remain committed to tackling climate change? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Super Happy Magic Forest
programme.desc: The Gnome Crystal Mine has ground to a halt, leaving the forest with no crystals, no power supply and melting ice lollies! The heroes are tasked with a quest to find out what has happened and to fix it. It turns out that a slimy beast named Smarg has made the mine her home. But with Hoofius's fear of gunk getting the better of him, evicting the slippery Smarg is not going to be easy. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Grizzy and the Lemmings: World Tour.
Pokémon Horizons
programme.sub-title: Liko and Hattrem, Bonded by Happiness!

programme.title: Winx Club – The Magic Is Back
Blue Peter: Children in Need SPOTacular.
Around the World in 80 Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don visits the world's 80 most inspiring gardens, this time in south east Asia. Since the 19th century, western gardeners have loved tropical gardens. Monty visits the archetype – the mysterious Jim Thompson's Garden in Bangkok. He seeks something more authentic in the Royal Palace gardens and the floating gardens of the canals of Bangkok. In Bali, his preconceptions are challenged again. Is the western picture of the exotic garden a construct? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: My Life at Christmas: Anita Rani Meets Rod Stewart and Penny Lancaster.
programme.desc: In a rare in-depth interview, Sir Rod Stewart and Penny Lancaster welcome Anita Rani into their home to discuss their lives, family, fame and faith, and how Christmases past and present have shaped them. Across an intimate fireside chat, Christmas crafting in a festive greenhouse and a stroll around the stunning grounds of their countryside home, they reflect on Rod's rise to fame, Penny's journey from model to special constable and festive traditions, including exchanging gifts with Elton John. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Nadiya's Everyday Baking
programme.desc: Nadiya presents the very best weekend breakfasts for kicking back, relaxing and really indulging in the pleasure of the day's first meal. And, of course, they are all easy, effortless and baked in the oven. First up are Nadiya's delectable granola cupcakes for a delicious breakfast on the go. A sticky fruit-and-nut granola shell is filled with chocolate and yoghurt before being crowned with edible flowers and fruit. Next, Nadiya offers up a refreshing start to the day with a kiwi, mint and spinach smoothie packed with energy-boosting oats. And, for a little indulgence at the weekend, this vibrant fruity delight is topped with crispy coconut croissant bites, a flurry of crushed frozen raspberries and a drizzle of yoghurt and honey. Nadiya's sweet breakfast wraps have a deliciously gooey baked banana and peanut butter filling, encased in a sugary, spiced tortilla wrap and drizzled with decadent dark chocolate. They are a perfectly indulgent way to relax into the weekend, as a batch can be baked in a matter of minutes. Finally, Nadiya shares one of her best-ever rule-breaking recipes. She takes the traditional English fry-up to a new level by turning it into a pizza topping. Pillowy soft pizza dough with a crisp crust, smothered in a tomato and baked bean base and topped with succulent sausage, moreish mushrooms, tangy cheese, crispy onions and a perfectly runny egg. This might not be one for the purists, but it is the breakfast of champions. Meanwhile, 18-year-old baker Kitty Tait from Oxfordshire shares her ingenious recipe for za'atar honey and feta swirls. At just 14, Kitty started to suffer from debilitating anxiety, but with the help of her dad, discovered that the simple pleasure of baking bread transformed her mental health. Kitty's love of baking blossomed, and she now runs an acclaimed artisan bakery and is definitely a star of the future. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Film: Ice Cold In Alex
programme.desc: During the German offensive in Libya in 1942, Captain Anson, commander of a motor ambulance convoy, finds himself cut off from his unit with only an old ambulance to take him back to Alexandria. His companions are two young nurses and his sergeant, Tom Pugh. As the little party sets off on the long journey, they meet Van der Poel, a South African captain who begs a lift. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Homes Under the Hammer
programme.desc: In Nottingham, we see a Victorian town house with an unusual back garden, a couple hope to transform a dilapidated mid-terrace in Bournemouth, and a one-bedroom flat becomes an ultra-modern two-bedroom in north London. Dion, Martin and Tommy meet the successful bidders as we follow three unique renovations. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Görevimiz Yemek
programme.desc: İki gurme yazar Mehmet Yaşin ve Teoman Hünal'la geziyoruz, yiyoruz, görüyoruz, öğreniyoruz. "Görevimiz Yemek" iki ustanın samimi, çekişmeli, eğlenceli sohbetiyle iştahınızı açacak. Türkiye'nin birçok yerinde göreceğimiz bu iki üstat gittikleri yerlerde yediklerini, içtiklerini kendi tarzlarına göre yorumluyorlar ve zaman zaman ayrı fikirlere düşüp birbirleriyle karşı karşıya geliyorlar. İki farklı tarzı barındıran ve her ikisi de alanının birer dehası olan Yaşin ve Hünal yemek için bulundukları mekanlarda, eğlenceli atışmalı sohbetin ortasına atıveriyorlar bizi. Ortam bazen kızışacak bazen samimi bir hal alacak bazen de eğlenceden dört köşe olacak. Aynı hikayeyi yaşayan iki kafadar gurmeye sizler de ekranlardan eşlik ederken büyük keyif alacak, esprili, nefis bir sohbetin tam ortasında bulacaksınız kendinizi. Bazen modern bazen otantik bir hale bürünecek olan program "Görevimiz Yemek" iki eski dostun birbirleriyle olan samimiyetinden doğan zevkli sataşmalarının olacağı bölümlerle ekranlarda olacak. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: De laatste lach
programme.desc: Zes mensen die ongeneeslijk ziek zijn kiezen voor de troost van de lach. Ze geven een humorist een bijzondere opdracht: schrijf een grafrede, maar dan wel eentje om te lachen. Om die afscheidsspeech te schrijven, moeten ze elkaar leren kennen. Philippe Geubels, Jade Mintjens, Janne Desmet, Otto Jan Ham, Pedro Elias en Wim Helsen duiken telkens in een leven vol verhalen om inspiratie op te doen voor hun tekst. Ze brengen elk op hun eigen manier een eerbetoon dat even persoonlijk als humoristisch is. Nog vóór de grafrede op hun uitvaart gebracht wordt, krijgen deze mensen zelf te horen wat er na hun dood over hen verteld zal worden. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: De goldies
programme.sub-title: Plat liggen is ook een sport
programme.desc: De goldies volgt de avonturen van Flory, Maria, Mieke, Monique en Viv. Vijf vrouwen die volgens hun identiteitskaart "op leeftijd" zijn, maar daar zelf weinig boodschap aan hebben. Samen bewijzen ze dat vriendschap, dromen, nieuwsgierigheid en avontuur van alle leeftijden zijn. Dat ouder worden niet hetzelfde is als stilvallen. Met hun aanstekelijke levenslust en gevoel voor humor geven ze een gezicht aan hun generatie. Ze hebben elk hun verhaal en hun rugzak, maar zijn ook de koninginnen van het relativeren. Samen delen ze lief en leed, maar vooral dezelfde goesting in het leven en in alles wat nog komt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: De laatste lach
programme.desc: Zes mensen die ongeneeslijk ziek zijn kiezen voor de troost van de lach. Ze geven een humorist een bijzondere opdracht: schrijf een grafrede, maar dan wel eentje om te lachen. Om die afscheidsspeech te schrijven, moeten ze elkaar leren kennen. Philippe Geubels, Jade Mintjens, Janne Desmet, Otto Jan Ham, Pedro Elias en Wim Helsen duiken telkens in een leven vol verhalen om inspiratie op te doen voor hun tekst. Ze brengen elk op hun eigen manier een eerbetoon dat even persoonlijk als humoristisch is. Nog vóór de grafrede op hun uitvaart gebracht wordt, krijgen deze mensen zelf te horen wat er na hun dood over hen verteld zal worden. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Intrede Sint R2026
programme.desc: Op zaterdag 14 november komt Sinterklaas met zijn stoomboot aan in Antwerpen. Samen met zijn beste vrienden trekt hij naar de Grote Markt, waar hij duizenden kinderen toespreekt. Beleef de feestelijke intrede live! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Dierendokters 24/7
programme.desc: Bulldog Walter is van de trap gevallen. Hij kan zijn achterpoten niet meer bewegen en reageert nauwelijks op pijnprikkels. De brandweer van zone Centrum komt naar de faculteit om te leren omgaan met grote dieren. Dat is een deel van de basisopleiding tot brandweerman. Bibi is een shetlandpony. Hij wordt binnengebracht met hoefbevangenheid, een zeer pijnlijke en moeilijk te bestrijden aandoening. Bokje Rudy lijkt goed te reageren op de behandeling tegen listeriose. Maar eet hij opnieuw voldoende? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Flikken Maastricht
programme.desc: Een jonge vrouw, moeder van twee kinderen, wordt dood aangetroffen in de zijtak van de Maas. Ze heeft een afscheidsbriefje achtergelaten en de politie concludeert dat ze zelfmoord gepleegd heeft. Maar haar moeder, burgemeester van een dorp in de buurt van Maastricht, kan dat niet geloven en haalt Wolfs en Eva erbij. Marion en Romeo doen onderzoek naar Marions buurmeisje. Is ze verdwenen en wat is er dan met haar gebeurd? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Witse
programme.desc: Er komen nu toch twee opeenvolgende eisen tot geldoverdracht. De twee afpersers vinden de dood. Voor Wijtinckx is alles nu opgelost. Maar Witse is er zeker van dat het echte brein achter de zaak nog actief is, en hij blijft zich vastbijten in de zaak. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Kijk uit
programme.desc: Snelheid blijft een van de belangrijkste oorzaken van ernstige verkeersongevallen. Daarom zetten steden en gemeenten in op sensibilisering en handhaving. (Senderinfo).

programme.desc: S2 E8 — Eines der steilsten Couloirs in Trentino - Canale dei BureloniDieses Mal geht es ans Limit: Tao bezwingt eines der steilsten Couloirs der Dolomiten.

programme.title: Wanderlust!
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Der Trockenmauerweg auf MallorcaAbseits des Massentourismus hat Mallorca eine unbekannte Seite, eine Wanderseite. Der Film begleitet Bradley Mayhew auf Mallorcas Trockenmauerweg. In sechs Etappen führt er entlang des Küstengebirges, durch Steineichenwälder und Olivenhaine, über Felsgrate und durch schöne Dörfer, immer mit bester Aussicht auf Berge und Meer.

programme.title: Auf schmalem Grat - Bergretter
programme.desc: Bergretter aus der Reichenau - ein Blick auf Mut, seine Grenzen und den Unterschied zu Waghalsigkeit. Gerade im alpinen Gelände ist Mut eine wesentliche Voraussetzung dafür, dass Expeditionen gelingen. Doch was macht ihn aus und wo zeigen sich Grenzen? Die Doku begleitet die freiwilligen Bergretter aus der Reichenau und den Extremsportler Mich Kemeter und berichtet von dem Balanceakt, der mutige Entscheidungen von waghalsigen unterscheidet.

programme.title: Heimatleuchten
programme.desc: E88 — Das Villgratental - Von Rebellen und VordenkernDiesmal werden die Menschen und Traditionen im Villgratental in Osttirol vorgestellt. programme.title: Faszination Heimat
programme.desc: S3 E15 — Vergessene Keller - Geheime StollenDer Höhlenforscher Robert Bouchal ist auf Entdeckungsreise in der österreichischen Unterwelt. Ganz besonders haben es ihm die menschengemachten Höhlen angetan: Alte Stollen, verfallene Zisternen, vergessene Kellergewölbe.

programme.title: Inn - Der grüne Fluss der Alpen
programme.desc: Eine Reise von der Quelle in den Albula-Alpen über Lunghinpass und Seen bis zu Geschichte und Kultur. Ausgehend von seiner ruhigen Quelle in den majestätischen Albula-Alpen im Engadin führt der Film durch eine malerische Landschaft bis nach Altfinstermünz. Verschiedene Orte zeigen eindrucksvoll, was diese Landschaft zu bieten hat: die einzigartige Wasserscheide am Lunghinpass, wo der Blick in drei Richtungen schweift und die Flüsse Po, Rhein und Inn ihren Weg in verschiedene Meere finden.

programme.title: Inn - Der grüne Fluss der Alpen
programme.desc: Das Tiroler Oberland - von Pfunds über historische Orte und unberührte Natur bis zum Apfelanbau in Haiming. Beginnend in Pfunds, dem Tor zum Tiroler Oberland, gewährt der mächtige Gasthof zum Thurm, früher eine wichtige Befestigungsanlage an der alten Innbrücke, einen Blick hinter seine Mauern. Auch antike Geschichte findet man hier: Entlang der Via Claudia Augusta, einer historischen Römerstraße, lässt sich eindrucksvoll die Naturkulisse der Hochufer des Inns bestaunen.

programme.title: Inn - Der grüne Fluss der Alpen
programme.desc: Natur und Kultur entlang des Inns - von Haiming über Innsbruck bis ins Karwendel. Eindrucksvolle Bilder zeigen ein faszinierendes Panorama der Naturwunder und kulturellen Schätze, die sich entlang des grünen Flusses zwischen Haiming und Hall entfalten. Die üppige Vegetation an den Ufern stellt Schauplätze unberührter Natur dar, wie etwa im Forchet bei Haiming, dem letzten geschützten Naturwald des Inntals.

programme.title: Traumberge Trentino - Pale bis Fersental

programme.title: Von der Zugspitze zum Achensee
programme.desc: Die Reise beginnt an der Zugspitze und führt durch das Grenzgebiet zwischen Bayern und Tirol. Über Ehrwald und den selten wasserführenden Igelsee geht es weiter zum Schmugglersteig und zum Königshaus am Schachen. Auch Mittenwald mit seinen historischen Häusern wird besucht. Ein Rundflug über die Bergwelt und die Drei-Zinken-Spitze bildet den letzten Höhepunkt, bevor die Reise schließlich am Achensee endet.

programme.title: Vom Grossglockner in die Karnischen Alpen
programme.desc: Vom Glockner in die karnischen AlpenDie Sendung zeigt einzigartige Aufnahmen aus der Luft vom legendären Großglockner. Den höchsten Berg Österreichs zu erklimmen ist wohl der Wunsch von vielen heimischen Bergsteigern. Murmeltiere balgen sich hier ohne Scheu in den sattgrünen Wiesen.

programme.title: Planet Weltweit
programme.desc: Peloponnes - Die Pioniere des WaldgartensEs wird gezeigt, wie der Peloponnes durch Permakultur und Agroforstwirtschaft wieder aufblühen soll.

programme.title: NZZ Format
programme.desc: In der Sendung dreht sich alles um die Zitrone. An den Zitronenbäumen wachsen gleichzeitig Blüten und Früchte. Die Zitronen von der Amalfiküste im Golf von Salerno sind besonders schmackhaft, aber auf den steilen Terrassen schwierig zu ernten. programme.desc: Passionnés de cinéma depuis le lycée, Doug et Griff ont toujours voulu réaliser leurs propres films. Lorsque l'occasion se présente de faire un reboot d'ANACONDA avec Ice Cube, leur film favori, les deux amis sautent sur l'occasion. programme.title: Running Man
programme.desc:
Amerika in der Zukunft. Statt der Regierung kontrolliert mittlerweile ein Fernsehsender, das „Network“ genannt, den faschistischen Staat, steuert Politik und Nachrichten gleichermaßen. Der Großteil der Menschen lebt in Armut. Aufstiegschancen hat nur, wer an mörderischen Spiel- und Realityshows des Networks teilnimmt. Um Geld für seine kranke Tochter aufzutreiben, lässt sich Ben Richards auf die gefährlichste aller Shows ein: „The Running Man“. Wer dort teilnimmt, ist für 30 Tage vogelfrei. 

Professionelle Jäger und der Rest der Bevölkerung dürfen einen durch das ganze Land jagen. Das Ziel: solange wie möglich überleben. Schafft man den Monat, winken Reichtum und Macht. Doch schnell ahnt Richards, dass das Spiel getürkt ist. Während er durch die USA flieht, regt sich Widerstand – mit ihm als Symbolfigur der Rebellion… 

Näher am Originalroman als die 1987er-Verfilmung mit Arnold Schwarzenegger, ist das flotte Remake von Edgar Wright („Hot Fuzz“) eine bissige Satire auf ein gewaltbereites Amerika, das nur noch vom Reality-TV zusammengehalten wird. Wright setzt auf turboschnelle, virtuose Verfolgungsjagden und Schusswechsel und hält sich mit politischem Subtext nicht zurück. Nicht alles fließt perfekt ineinander, aber es ist erfrischend, aus Hollywoods Blockbuster-Schmiede etwas so Anarchisches zu bekommen.

programme.title: Cash Out 3 : The Gentleman Thief
programme.desc: L'incorrigible Shawn réussit, non sans mal, à sortir son frère Mason Goddard de sa retraite pour l'embarquer dans un ultime casse. Mais Mason et son équipe d'experts en cambriolage vont, sans le savoir, s'attaquer au redoutable Abel Salazar qui vient de s'évader de prison. Ce casse de haut vol, apparemment à leur portée, a en réalité été imaginé par Salazar lui-même, et ne vise qu'à les piéger. Mais Mason n'est pas homme à se laisser faire si facilement. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Les génies de la nature
programme.desc: Dans un territoire grand comme la Bretagne, à la frontière des Balkans, la Slovénie concentre une densité du vivant qui défie l'entendement. Ours, loups, lynx, rapaces et pollinisateurs en tout genre peuplent les vallées boisées et les prairies alpines qui couvrent près de 60 % du territoire. Plus singulier encore, un réseau souterrain de galeries s'étend sur des centaines de kilomètres sous les plateaux calcaires, abritant une faune cavernicole parmi les plus riches et les plus endémiques du monde. Accompagnée de biologistes, de naturalistes et de chercheurs qui consacrent leur vie à ces espèces, Marat part à la découverte d'animaux et d'organismes qui incarnent, chacun à leur façon, le génie évolutif du vivant. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Miniature Wife

programme.title: Miniature Wife

programme.title: Veuillez patienter
programme.desc: Laurent et Sophie font appel au service Gagu, le spécialiste du montage de meubles à domicile, pour monter en 1H chrono le berceau de la petite Lea qui est attendue dans quelques semaines. Mais Laurent et Sophie n'ont pas opté pour l'option départ automatique, et leur \" GaguMan \" va finalement passer un peu plus d'une heure chez eux… (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Mortelle raclette
programme.desc: L'héritier d'une boîte de films X décide de faire évoluer le genre en engageant, pour son nouveau film TIRE-FESSES, une coordinatrice d'intimité également formée aux tournages éco-responsables. Une première pour elle. Et pour l'équipe qu'elle va accompagner. Mais la petite troupe, en tournage dans un chalet savoyard isolé, va vite se retrouver coupée du monde par une tempête de neige et une panne de wi-fi. Pendant ce temps, à quelques centaines de mètres, un glacier rejette vivant un chasseur alpin disparu en 1888, qui va découvrir que l'équipe du film squatte son ancien chalet. Pas de bol, il est gymnophobe (phobique de la nudité). (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Alexandre Kominek : Bâtard sensible
programme.desc: C'est un Polonais Tunisien né en Suisse… Ça pourrait être le début d'une blague donc il a décidé d'en faire un spectacle. Alexandre Kominek confirme une trajectoire à part, celle d'un humoriste qui avance sans chercher à arrondir les angles. Son humour frontal bouscule et met à nu les contradictions contemporaines comme le désir, la masculinité ou les rapports sociaux. "Alexandre Kominek est une véritable machine. Pendant 1 heure et 46 minutes, il nous attrape et nous enlace dans une danse endiablée, à grands coups d'histoires aussi folles qu'authentiques. Les délires de votre ami le plus fou ne valent rien à côté de ceux d'Alexandre. Sincère, animal, espiègle, charmeur, fragile, romantique, excessif… L'humoriste suisse est un peu tout ça à la fois. Et plus encore ! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Grizzy und die Lemminge

programme.title: Grizzy und die Lemminge

programme.title: Mr. Bean - Die Cartoon-Serie

programme.title: Mr. Bean - Die Cartoon-Serie

programme.title: Grizzy und die Lemminge
programme.desc: Grizzly hat sich etwas zu essen vorbereitet und will nun bei seiner Lieblingssendung speisen. Doch kaum sitzt er vor dem Fernseher, ist das Bild nicht klar. programme.title: Grizzy und die Lemminge
